summary: Run app-owned Fractal web Storybook stories through the existing strict kit play runner in the web CI execution step, independently of the kit input filter.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: No protocol or checkpoint rule changes.

compatibility.detail: CI adds an app-only story index and the same 440/1440 dark/light strict play matrix with the a11y addon. The independent kit index is unchanged.

manual.detail: The existing CI execution step runs app plays automatically; local build and play commands are documented in the kit README.

recovery.detail: Revert the CI/configuration change; no persistent data changes.
